idh.reasoning: The MRI metadata shows an aggressive solitary right-sided infiltrative mass with substantial non-enhancing/necrotic component, edema, mass effect, ventricular/ependymal involvement, deep white-matter invasion, and satellites. These features favor an IDH-wildtype diffuse glioma phenotype over an IDH-mutant glioma. The main counterweight is the relatively young age of 41 years, which is more compatible with IDH-mutant adult-type diffuse glioma, and the enhancement is described as mild with a low enhancing proportion, which can be seen in IDH-mutant tumors. On balance, the aggressive invasion and necrotic/edematous phenotype support IDH-wildtype as the best estimate.
